issue_title: POST body is lost on some redirects
issue_body: When a POST request is redirected, the request body is sometimes dropped: the redirected request arrives with no body even though the redirect is of a type that is meant to preserve the original method and body. Other redirect types are handled correctly. Affected requests keep the POST method but lose their payload.

expected_behavior: 307 redirect preserves the request body for re-submission.
307 redirect preserves the original request method.
301 and 302 redirects for POST still change method to GET and drop body.
303 redirect still always uses GET with no body.
308 redirect still preserves method and body.
